scientific_question: Does the natural-image bridge fail because the oracle footprint is overprecise, because the frozen decoder is too small, because extraction does not generalize, or because frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 patches lack the required object information?

frozen_upstream.transitive_ledger: The upstream tag transitively freezes C0-v2, C1-v2.1 candidate identities and production scale, D13/D14/D15, WM-v2A/B/B.1/C-EJ, camera contract, natural image-space target audit, all prior mechanism results, and their reports/results/checkpoints.

calibration.use: all teacher bins, oracle screening, decoder fitting, thresholding, early stopping, ridge selection, and freezing

development_evaluation.use: one-shot frozen development evaluation, not blind confirmation

B0-soft-area.definition: 49 exact relevant-object cell occupancy fractions plus exact continuous visible-area fraction

B1-binary.visible_area: not stored; diagnostic area is mean binary occupancy

B3-ordinal.visible_area: not stored; diagnostic area is mean ordinal code

B4-binary-coarse-area.role: binary localization plus one coarse-scale alternative

distance.B0-soft-area: mean absolute difference over 49 occupancy values plus area
distance.B2-binary-area: mean absolute difference over 49 binary cells plus continuous area
distance.B3-ordinal: mean absolute ordinal-code difference over 49 cells
distance.B4-binary-coarse-area: mean absolute difference over 49 binary cells plus coarse area code

calibration_screen.rule: Train natural decoders only when calibration leave-one-init-out oracle features clear one raw target, one EE-conditioned residual target, and retain at least 80 percent of B0 gain on one raw target.

decoders.allowed_inputs: frozen natural CLIP ViT-B/32 patch features [49,512] only

C3-local-context.spatial_layers: one 3x3 depthwise convolution plus one 1x1 pointwise convolution
C3-local-context.area_layers: pooled contextual 32-D feature to width32 head

decoders.early_stopping: Within each leave-one-init-out calibration fold retain the epoch with minimum validation training objective; final epoch is round-half-up median of four fold epochs.
decoders.threshold_selection: maximize calibration OOF IoU, then balanced accuracy, then choose lower threshold
decoders.binary_loss: BCEWithLogits with calibration-derived positive weight clipped to [1,20]
decoders.ordinal_loss: three-class cross entropy with calibration-derived inverse-frequency weights clipped to [0.25,20]
decoders.continuous_area_loss: sigmoid MSE weighted by 10 in the joint objective
decoders.coarse_area_loss: three-class cross entropy with calibration-derived inverse-frequency weights clipped to [0.25,20]

pair_summaries.role: fixed low-capacity downstream probe feature, not an additional deployment target

probes.selection: leave-one-init-state-out CV within init31-34; exact tie favors larger alpha
targets: ObjMask residual after calibration EE-only fit
Area residual after calibration EE-only fit

shuffle.rule: derange the entire six-dimensional new spatial summary across branch points within identical task, horizon, and candidate pair while global features and target remain fixed

bootstrap.unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all 24 pair/horizon rows

gates.shuffle_rule: relative degradation positive with branch-bootstrap CI lower above zero
gates.oracle_simplified_pass: one ObjMask/Area primary target clears 10 percent, positive CI, shuffle, 7 tasks, 4 horizons, all pairs; one EE-conditioned residual clears 5 percent with positive CI; and the primary gain retains at least 80 percent of B0
gates.deployment_bridge_pass: the same natural design clears natural recovery, one ObjMask/Area primary target at 10 percent with positive CI and shuffle, 7 tasks, 4 horizons, all pairs, and one EE-conditioned residual at 5 percent with positive CI

decision.go_scope: seed11 single-model offline spatial World Model mechanism prototype only

full_patch_reference.role: frozen information reference only; no high-capacity full-patch model may be trained

candidate_headroom_reference.gate_role: discussion only; does not alter extraction gates

preflight_correction_history.phase: after calibration and before development evaluation
preflight_correction_history.issue: The user's explicit Section-44 binary-teacher-failure mapping required SOFT_FOOTPRINT_INFORMATION_REQUIRED, but the initial implementation copied the shorter Section-43 allowed-label list and omitted that label.
preflight_correction_history.correction: Add the explicitly required label and map failure of oracle B1 to target-simplification block before considering the frozen-CLIP information-limit case.
preflight_correction_history.unchanged: teachers, thresholds, bins, decoder forms, losses, training, ridge probes, bootstrap, shuffles, numeric gates, partitions, and authorization outcomes
